turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and a client call at 4:40. Owen's mark went to zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Withdraw it.
"Get this over with." My son's grade isn't an errand, Hale. On what basis did you enter that zero, and who decided?
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
"Everyone knows it." Who is everyone, Hale, and what exactly have they seen? I'm writing that down, and you're calling my son a cheater with nothing in front of me.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
"Bully anyone." I asked who decided and on what basis, and you haven't answered either. Is there a document, Hale, or is the zero all you have?
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
"Wasting my time." You gave my son a zero before you called me, and you still haven't put one page in front of me. Withdraw it, or show me what you have.
